subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the B57 across all 11 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The B57 is one of the broadest-application diesel engines we work on — the same base engine across 11 model lines, spanning saloons, coupes, estates, and SUVs.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild. Additional components are inspected and measured — crankshaft, cylinder head, VANOS components, oil pump, cooling system, fuel injectors, HPFP, turbocharger, PCV system.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the B57 across any of its 11 applications. The B57 is the successor to the N57 and features improved design throughout — for the B57, we don't have a specific failure pattern to report, and we won't invent one to sound more thorough.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed B57 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
